description: Discover the rest of the BlackOps tool catalog. This connector surfaces a small default tool set; every other BlackOps capability (pages, video, brains and brain watches, hunts, sorties, LinkedIn/Threads/Medium, GA4/Search Console analytics, and more) is one lookup away. Call with no arguments for the full index of tool names, with query to search, or with names for complete definitions including input_schema. Then invoke any of them with use_tool.

limit.description: Max full definitions returned for a query (default 5).

names.description: Exact tool names to fetch full definitions for.

query.description: Keyword search over tool names and descriptions (case-insensitive).

name: describe_tools
title: Describe Tools
